architectural_references.sql:
CREATE TABLE architectural_references (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	source_platform VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	source_url VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	creator_name VARCHAR(255), 
	creator_url VARCHAR(500), 
	thumbnail_url VARCHAR(1000), 
	media_url VARCHAR(1000), 
	video_embed_id VARCHAR(100), 
	category_id INTEGER, 
	material_tags TEXT, 
	location_context VARCHAR(255), 
	verification_status VARCHAR(50), 
	description TEXT, 
	retrieval_method VARCHAR(50), 
	content_availability_status VARCHAR(50), 
	inspiration_image_url VARCHAR(1000), 
	inspiration_source_url VARCHAR(1000), 
	manufacturer_product_image_url VARCHAR(1000), 
	manufacturer_product_url VARCHAR(1000), 
	manufacturer_id INTEGER, 
	product_match_status VARCHAR(50), 
	last_checked_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME, country VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'India', region VARCHAR(100), architectural_style VARCHAR(100), project_type VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Residential', architecture_era VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Contemporary', architect_name VARCHAR(255), content_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'architectural_project', video_duration VARCHAR(50), is_short BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'False', image_attribution VARCHAR(500), source_domain VARCHAR(100), colors_and_finishes VARCHAR(255), external_source_id VARCHAR(255), search_keyword VARCHAR(255), date_collected VARCHAR(50), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES material_categories (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(manufacturer_id) REFERENCES manufacturers (id)
)

catalogue_categories.sql:
CREATE TABLE catalogue_categories (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	explorer_category_slug VARCHAR(150), 
	explorer_category_name VARCHAR(150), 
	description TEXT, 
	display_order INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

catalogue_import_runs.sql:
CREATE TABLE catalogue_import_runs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	file_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	total_csv_rows INTEGER, 
	inserted_rows INTEGER, 
	updated_rows INTEGER, 
	skipped_rows INTEGER, 
	categories_count INTEGER, 
	subcategories_count INTEGER, 
	distinct_materials_count INTEGER, 
	status VARCHAR(50), 
	notes TEXT, 
	imported_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

catalogue_materials.sql:
CREATE TABLE catalogue_materials (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	category_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	subcategory_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	normalized_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	source_row_number INTEGER, 
	source_dataset VARCHAR(255), 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_catalogue_material_subcat_name UNIQUE (subcategory_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES catalogue_categories (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(subcategory_id) REFERENCES catalogue_subcategories (id)
)

catalogue_subcategories.sql:
CREATE TABLE catalogue_subcategories (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	category_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	category_subcategory_key VARCHAR(350) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_catalogue_subcat_cat_name UNIQUE (category_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES catalogue_categories (id)
)

custom_keywords.sql:
CREATE TABLE custom_keywords (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	keyword VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	category_name VARCHAR(150), 
	is_followed BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

daily_collection_records.sql:
CREATE TABLE daily_collection_records (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	collection_date VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(100), 
	keyword VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	requested_quantity INTEGER, 
	actual_quantity INTEGER, 
	status VARCHAR(50), 
	error_details TEXT, 
	completion_timestamp DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

inspiration_materials.sql:
CREATE TABLE inspiration_materials (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reference_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	category_id INTEGER, 
	category_slug VARCHAR(100), 
	material_category VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	element_location VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	identification_type VARCHAR(50), 
	verification_status VARCHAR(50), 
	confidence_score FLOAT, 
	detail_image_url VARCHAR(1000), 
	notes TEXT, 
	product_id INTEGER, 
	compatible_alternatives TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reference_id) REFERENCES architectural_references (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES material_categories (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
)

manufacturers.sql:
CREATE TABLE manufacturers (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	company_name VARCHAR(255), 
	slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	country VARCHAR(100), 
	official_website VARCHAR(500), 
	official_catalog_url VARCHAR(500), 
	official_product_page_url VARCHAR(500), 
	official_video_channel_url VARCHAR(500), 
	description TEXT, 
	logo_url VARCHAR(500), 
	contact_info TEXT, 
	verification_status VARCHAR(50), 
	last_verified_at DATETIME, 
	source_url VARCHAR(500), 
	unverified_notes TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

material_categories.sql:
CREATE TABLE material_categories (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	image_url VARCHAR(500), section_code VARCHAR(10), section_name VARCHAR(150), typical_applications TEXT, subcategories TEXT, standards_compliance TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

products.sql:
CREATE TABLE products (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	manufacturer_id INTEGER, 
	category_id INTEGER, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	sku_code VARCHAR(100), 
	product_type VARCHAR(100), 
	material_type VARCHAR(150), 
	material_composition TEXT, 
	finish VARCHAR(100), 
	color VARCHAR(100), 
	intended_use VARCHAR(255), 
	dimensions VARCHAR(100), 
	thickness VARCHAR(50), 
	installation_requirements TEXT, 
	specs TEXT, 
	official_product_url VARCHAR(500), 
	official_catalog_url VARCHAR(500), 
	country_of_manufacture VARCHAR(100), 
	image_url VARCHAR(500), 
	data_source VARCHAR(100), 
	verification_status VARCHAR(50), 
	last_checked_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(manufacturer_id) REFERENCES manufacturers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES material_categories (id)
)

quotation_requests.sql:
CREATE TABLE quotation_requests (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quantity VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	dimensions VARCHAR(100), 
	project_location VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	city VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	pin_code VARCHAR(20), 
	delivery_urgency VARCHAR(50), 
	additional_notes TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(50), 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers (id)
)

quotation_responses.sql:
CREATE TABLE quotation_responses (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quotation_request_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	quoted_price FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(10), 
	estimated_delivery_days INTEGER, 
	delivery_terms TEXT, 
	response_message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quotation_request_id) REFERENCES quotation_requests (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers (id)
)

reference_product_matches.sql:
CREATE TABLE reference_product_matches (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reference_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	match_type VARCHAR(50), 
	match_confidence FLOAT, 
	evidence_notes TEXT, 
	verification_status VARCHAR(50), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reference_id) REFERENCES architectural_references (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
)

saved_items.sql:
CREATE TABLE saved_items (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	item_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	reference_id INTEGER, 
	product_id INTEGER, 
	supplier_id INTEGER, 
	project_collection VARCHAR(100), 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reference_id) REFERENCES architectural_references (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers (id)
)

source_connectors.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_connectors (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	platform VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	sync_frequency_minutes INTEGER, 
	last_synced_at DATETIME, 
	status VARCHAR(50), 
	total_items_fetched INTEGER, 
	config_json TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (platform)
)

source_sync_logs.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_sync_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	connector_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	items_ingested INTEGER, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	timestamp DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(connector_id) REFERENCES source_connectors (id)
)

supplier_products.sql:
CREATE TABLE supplier_products (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	match_type VARCHAR(50), 
	supplier_product_code VARCHAR(100), 
	price FLOAT, 
	currency VARCHAR(10), 
	price_unit VARCHAR(50), 
	availability_status VARCHAR(50), 
	stock_status VARCHAR(50), 
	stock_confirmed_at DATETIME, 
	available_quantity FLOAT, 
	min_order_quantity VARCHAR(100), 
	delivery_scope VARCHAR(50), 
	estimated_lead_time_days INTEGER, 
	listing_url VARCHAR(500), 
	verification_status VARCHAR(50), 
	last_confirmed_date DATETIME, 
	last_updated_at DATETIME, 
	notes TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
)

suppliers.sql:
CREATE TABLE suppliers (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	business_type VARCHAR(100), 
	contact_person VARCHAR(255), 
	address VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	city VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	district VARCHAR(100), 
	state VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	pin_code VARCHAR(20), 
	country VARCHAR(100), 
	latitude FLOAT, 
	longitude FLOAT, 
	phone VARCHAR(50), 
	email VARCHAR(255), 
	website VARCHAR(500), 
	google_maps_url VARCHAR(500), 
	google_place_id VARCHAR(255), 
	gstin VARCHAR(50), 
	brands_distributed TEXT, 
	delivery_areas TEXT, 
	verification_status VARCHAR(50), 
	verification_method VARCHAR(100), 
	verification_notes TEXT, 
	is_potential BOOLEAN, 
	delivery_radius_km FLOAT, 
	last_updated_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME, whatsapp VARCHAR(50), instagram_url VARCHAR(500), materials_sold TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

users.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	hashed_password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	full_name VARCHAR(255), 
	role VARCHAR(50), 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
